panels.title: Decode errors
panels.description:
Frames the client failed to decode, or decoded corrupt, on every stream.

Green ≤ 0, yellow ≤ 0, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", result!="ok"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Lost frames
panels.description:
Frames that never reached the client's decoder on streams with nothing dropped.

Green ≤ 0, yellow ≤ 3, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_missing_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Frame pacing p99
panels.description:
The 99th percentile of the time between frames arriving at the client on clean streams, in frame intervals: 1 is perfect pacing.

Green ≤ 1.1 frames, yellow ≤ 1.5 frames, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frame_interval_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range]))) * $fps

panels.title: Delivered frame rate
panels.description:
Frames the client received per second on clean streams, as a share of the stream's frame rate.

Green ≥ 99%, yellow ≥ 90%, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: 100 * histogram_count(sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frame_interval_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range]))) / histogram_sum(sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frame_interval_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range]))) / $fps

panels.title: Host latency p99
panels.description:
The 99th percentile of Moonshine's time on the host from capturing a frame to sending its last packet.

Green ≤ 3 ms, yellow ≤ 8 ms, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: 1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum((last_over_time(moonshine_frame_duration_seconds{frame_kind=~"delta|key"}[$__range]) and on (stream_key) group by (stream_key) (last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range])))))

panels.title: Recovery time p95
panels.description:
The 95th percentile of how long the picture stood still after a lost frame, until a frame recovered it, in frame intervals.

Green ≤ 3 frames, yellow ≤ 8 frames, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_freeze_duration_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range]))) * $fps

panels.title: RFI recovery rate
panels.description:
The share of lost frames the stream recovered from with reference frame invalidation (RFI) instead of a keyframe.

Green ≥ 95%, yellow ≥ 50%, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: 100 * (histogram_count(sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_freeze_duration_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", recovered_by="recovery_frame"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / histogram_count(sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_freeze_duration_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Input latency p50
panels.description:
The median time from the client sending a click to it decoding the flash the click caused (to decoded, not to photons), in frame intervals.

Green ≤ 1 frames, yellow ≤ 2 frames, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_click_duration_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range]))) * $fps

panels.title: HDR switch keyframes
panels.description:
Keyframes Moonshine sent per change in the captured content's color space (SDR, HDR10, scRGB).

Green ≤ 0.7, yellow ≤ 1.2, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(moonshine_frames_total{frame_kind="key"}[$__range]) and on (stream_key) group by (stream_key) (last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range])))) / (sum((last_over_time(moonshine_content_switches_total{}[$__range]) and on (stream_key) group by (stream_key) (last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range])))) > 0)

panels.title: Peak bitrate
panels.description:

Green ≤ 110%, yellow ≤ 150%, red beyond. The thresholds are in targets.json.

targets.expr: 100 * max(last_over_time(moonshine_client_bitrate_peak_bit_per_second{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range])) / max(last_over_time(moonshine_client_bitrate_requested_bit_per_second{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec", stream="clean"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Host
panels.description: The machine Moonshine ran on, from gamestream-test-client's probe. GPU and driver: the GPU it encoded on (Vulkan).

targets.expr: last_over_time(moonshine_test_info{run="$run", role="host"}[$__range])

panels.title: Client
panels.description: The machine the test client ran on, from its probe. GPU and driver: the GPU it decoded on (VAAPI).

targets.expr: last_over_time(moonshine_test_info{run="$run", role="client"}[$__range])

panels.title: Build and stream
panels.description: The build under test, the baseline when there was one, the route between the machines (never an address), the stream's settings, and what the run recorded. Clock sync: how closely the client's times are placed on Moonshine's clock (half the fastest NTP round trip).

targets.expr: last_over_time(moonshine_test_info{run="$run", role="run"}[$__range])
count(count by (stream_key) (last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range])))
sum(last_over_time(moonshine_client_frames_total{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range]))
round(1000 * max(last_over_time(moonshine_client_clock_uncertainty_seconds{run="$run", side="$side", codec=~"$codec"}[$__range])), 0.01)
